layout.results/json_files/strong_form: per-arm records, strong form (both anchored and unanchored)
layout.data: dataset cache and FDM ground truth

naming.exception: The modes-5 base arms are s42a..s46a.json, but their checkpoints carry an m5_ prefix (m5_s42a_adam.pt). The multi-seed cell writes JSON as {tag}.json and checkpoints as m5_{tag}_adam.pt. Do NOT rename: the cell's resume check is os.path.exists({tag}.json), so renaming triggers a full retrain of all five arms.
naming.stem_pairing_warning: Any script pairing JSON to checkpoint by filename stem will silently drop the five m5 base arms.

m2_bs128.supports: batch-size axis; paired against m2_bs64_matched at equal steps

m2_bs64_matched.supports: primary weak-form reference arm; also the anchor-share measurement and the weak side of the XAI comparison

m2_bs64_full.supports: objective-accuracy misalignment: weak_total falls while flux and C_l2 worsen, 5/5 seeds, monotone

m5.note: n=5. s42b is NOT an independent sample and is excluded from every median.

m5_lbfgs100.config: L-BFGS re-polish at 100 steps from each saved m5 Adam checkpoint
m5_lbfgs100.supports: paired 100-vs-250 step comparison, 15/15 across 5 arms x 3 metrics

ab_matched / ab_full.supports: first pass at the unsupervised weak form; superseded at n=5 by dn_plain_noanchor
ab_matched / ab_full.note: n=2. Retained for provenance, not cited as a headline number.

dn_plain_noanchor.config: weak, plain reduction, W_ANCHOR=0, modes=2, bs=64, 7,205 steps
dn_plain_noanchor.supports: WEAK-FORM IDENTIFIABILITY FAILURE. C_l2 ~1.03 with negative x_corr: a non-solution, not a degraded one.

dn_dual_noanchor.config: weak, discrete dual norm R^T G^-1 R, W_ANCHOR=0
dn_dual_noanchor.supports: PRE-REGISTERED NEGATIVE RESULT. The dual norm does not restore identifiability; phi improves 4-5x, C does not follow.

dn_dual_anchored.supports: dual norm is actively harmful when supervision is present

sf_wbc1.config: strong form, W_BC=1, W_ANCHOR=1, bs=32, 82+246, 7,216 steps
sf_wbc1.supports: anchored strong control; sf_wbc1_s42 is the checkpoint used for all XAI and payload export

sf_wbc10 / sf_wbc100.supports: W_BC sweep. n=2 -- selects W_BC=1, not cited as a standalone result.

sa_wbc1_noanchor.config: strong form, W_BC=1, W_ANCHOR=0, bs=32, 7,216 steps
sa_wbc1_noanchor.supports: STRONG-FORM CONTROL. Identifies the solution without supervision where the weak form does not.

compiled.strong_form_n5.json: strong anchored vs unanchored at n=5, with per-seed pairing and range overlap. Supersedes any earlier strong-form range.
compiled.m5_n5.json: m5 arm statistics with s42b excluded
compiled.replicate_s42.json: single-seed determinism record, in weak_form/ (not an aggregation)
compiled.anchor_share_m2.json: gradient share of the supervised anchor, 50 draws, n=5
compiled.fdm_weak_residual.json: weak-form residual of the FDM reference

known_issues: sa_wbc1_noanchor s42/s43 store metrics at top level as 'hold'/'obj'; s44-s46 nest them under 'adam'. Read with: r['adam']['hold'] if 'adam' in r else r['hold'].

s42b.json, m5_s42b_lbfgs100.json and the three m5_s42b_*.pt files are not an independent sample. Rerunning seed 42 reproduces s42a bit-for-bit (max|dw| = 0), so s42b carries no information beyond s42a. Excluded from all medians; n=5, not 6.
m2_s42a.* is orphaned -- the single-seed baseline cell that produced it is no longer in main.ipynb. Superseded by m2_bs64_full_s42 at the same config.

constraints.batch_size_strong: bs=32 is a hardware ceiling, not a design choice. bs>=64 OOMs on the 20 GB MIG slice because the strong form builds second-derivative graphs. Strong and weak arms are matched on gradient steps (7,216 vs 7,205), not on batch size.
constraints.lbfgs_strong: L-BFGS was run and dropped for the strong form: worse on C_l2 in 10/10 weak arms and the only stage that OOMed. Strong-vs-weak is an Adam-vs-Adam comparison.
constraints.determinism: Training is bit-reproducible at fixed seed, verified by retraining seed 42 in a fresh process (max|dw| = 0, and held-out metrics identical to machine precision). All spread across seeds 42-46 is seed sensitivity, not run noise.

hardware: NVIDIA A100 MIG slice, 20,096 MiB (GI 2, CI 0), driver 470.199.02
caveat: Research output. The finite-difference reference carries unresolved potential-boundary and reaction-kinetics assumptions, so values are not calibrated corrosion current densities.
